description: A holiday-styled tabletop vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a wide lens, showing a densely styled surface covered with a dark forest-green textile runner. Loose raw-wood cutout Christmas tree ornaments are scattered around the bases. The entire arrangement glows with warm amber light radiating from within each glass dome, with the fairy lights creating scattered golden bokeh points. The background is a deep oxblood or burgundy-brown wall, making the golden warmth of the display stand out dramatically. The mood is rich, festive, and deeply warm.
